description: Options that control wireframe export output (PNG / PDF).

members.name: BackgroundColor
members.description: Background colour hex string (e.g. #ffffff). Empty = transparent.

members.name: IncludeBackground
members.description: Include page background colour in the output. Default true.

members.name: PageRange
members.description: For PDF exports: "all" or comma-separated page indices (0-based). Ignored for PNG.

members.name: Scale
members.description: Raster scale factor for PNG exports (1 = 1×, 2 = 2× retina, 3 = 3×). Ignored for PDF.
